newsitem.title: UK: European cotton buyers cautious ahead of new crops.
newsitem.headline: European cotton buyers cautious ahead of new crops.

text.p: Mill buyers of raw cotton reacted cautiously to indecisive movements in shipment offering prices, industry sources said.

They reported substantial uncertainty regarding northern hemisphere new crop sizes. In addition bad weather in some regions such as the Mediterranean raised questions about the range of qualities expected as harvesting gathers momentum.

The outlook for world supply is still to substantially exceed consumption. Recent business in main western European importing markets was limited with attention confined principally to popular central Asian and west African styles.
